arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
export CODEX_HOME=/home/ubuntu/.codex
export PATH=/home/ubuntu/codex-agent/node_modules/.bin:$PATH
unset OPENAI_API_KEY CODEX_API_KEY OPENAI_BASE_URL
printf 'LIVE_VPS_CODEX_CLI_TEST_BEGIN\n'
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os,sys,subprocess,shutil,tomllib,tempfile,pathlib
from pathlib import Path
exe=shutil.which("codex")
if not exe or not Path(exe).is_file():
 print("BLOCKER=CODEX_BINARY_MISSING")
 raise SystemExit(20)
p=subprocess.run([exe,"--version"],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=12)
if p.returncode!=0:
 print("BLOCKER=CODEX_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE")
 raise SystemExit(21)
print("CODEX_VERSION",p.stdout.strip()[:150])
home=Path(os.environ["CODEX_HOME"])
if not home.is_dir():
 print("BLOCKER=CODEX_HOME_NOT_FOUND")
 raise SystemExit(22)
p=subprocess.run([exe,"login","status"],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=18)
signed=(p.returncode==0 and "Logged in using ChatGPT" in p.stdout+p.stderr)
print("CHATGPT_LOGIN_VALID",signed,"STATUS_EXIT",p.returncode)
if not signed:
 print("BLOCKER=NOT_CHATGPT_SIGNED_IN")
 raise SystemExit(23)
config=home/"config.toml"
if config.is_file():
 obj=tomllib.loads(config.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 provider=obj.get("model_provider","openai")
 if provider!="openai":
  print("BLOCKER=CUSTOM_MODEL_PROVIDER",type(provider).__name__)
  raise SystemExit(24)
 base=(obj.get("model_providers") or {}).get("openai") or {}
 configured_url=base.get("base_url") if isinstance(base,dict) else None
 if configured_url and str(configured_url).rstrip("/")!="https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex":
  print("BLOCKER=CUSTOM_PROVIDER_ENDPOINT")
  raise SystemExit(25)
print("PROVIDER_AUTH_POLICY", "CHATGPT_ONLY_PASS")
root=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="rea-live-codex-vps-",dir="/tmp"))
root.chmod(0o700)
source=root/"source"
target="martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex"
branch="fix/rea-codex-worker-env-20261030"
sha="902079f6559880eaab8e6948b7c125c5b486de1c"
subprocess.run(["git","clone","--quiet","--depth","3","--branch",branch,"https://github.com/"+target+".git",str(source)],check=True,timeout=70)
head=subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(source),"rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
if head!=sha:
 print("BLOCKER=SOURCE_SHA_DRIFT",head)
 raise SystemExit(26)
print("SOURCE_SHA",head)
marker="codex/tests/rea_cli_vps_live_smoke_20261030.txt"
order={"request":"Verify that the existing Codex CLI can complete one small work item from the project-owned Coordinator in a private checkout.",
 "target_repository":target,
 "work_items":[{"id":"vps-smoke","task":"Create only the text file "+marker+" with one exact line CODEX_VPS_LIVE_WORKER_OK and a newline. Do not modify any other file; do not commit, push, open PRs or touch other projects.","paths":[marker],"reasoning_effort":"medium"}]}
order_path=root/"order.json"
order_path.write_text(json.dumps(order,ensure_ascii=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
env=dict(os.environ)
plan=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-m","codex.smart","plan","--order",str(order_path),"--repo-dir",str(source)],cwd=source,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=28)
if plan.returncode:
 print("BLOCKER=COORDINATOR_PLAN",plan.returncode,plan.stderr[:600])
 raise SystemExit(27)
planned=json.loads(plan.stdout)
print("COORDINATOR_MODE",planned.get("mode"),"AGENT_COUNT",planned.get("agent_count"),"STATUS",planned.get("status"))
assert planned["status"]=="planned" and planned["mode"]=="single" and planned["agent_count"]==1
print("MODEL_SELECTION",json.dumps([{"status":t["selection"]["status"],"provider":t["selection"]["provider"],"adapter":t["selection"]["adapter"],"model":t["selection"]["model"],"effort":t["selection"]["reasoning_effort"]} for t in planned["tasks"]]))
if not all(t["selection"]["status"]=="selected" and t["selection"]["provider"]=="codex" and t["selection"]["adapter"]=="codex-cli" for t in planned["tasks"]):
 print("BLOCKER=PROVIDER_NOT_SELECTED")
 raise SystemExit(28)
runs=root/"runs"
runs.mkdir(mode=0o700)
print("REAL_WORKER_LAUNCH",1,flush=True)
run=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-m","codex.smart","run","--order",str(order_path),"--repo-dir",str(source),"--runs-dir",str(runs),"--timeout","155","--execute"],cwd=source,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=210)
print("COORDINATOR_RUN_EXIT",run.returncode,flush=True)
if run.returncode:
 print("BLOCKER=WORKER_RUN_FAILED")
 print("WORKER_RUN_STDERR_SUMMARY",run.stderr[:900].replace("\n"," | "))
 print("WORKER_RUN_STDOUT_SUMMARY",run.stdout[-900:].replace("\n"," | "))
 raise SystemExit(29)
res=json.loads(run.stdout)
workers=res.get("workers") or []
if len(workers)!=1 or workers[0]["status"]!="completed":
 print("BLOCKER=WORKER_NOT_COMPLETED",json.dumps([{"id":w.get("id"),"status":w.get("status"),"exit":w.get("exit_code")} for w in workers]))
 raise SystemExit(30)
worker=workers[0]
workspace=Path(worker["workspace"])
file=workspace/marker
if not file.is_file() or file.read_bytes()!=b"CODEX_VPS_LIVE_WORKER_OK\n":
 print("BLOCKER=WORKER_FILE_INVALID")
 raise SystemExit(31)
if worker.get("out_of_scope") or worker.get("ref_changes") or worker.get("commit_detected"):
 print("BLOCKER=WORKER_SCOPE_VIOLATION")
 raise SystemExit(32)
if worker.get("new_paths")!=[marker]:
 print("BLOCKER=WORKER_EXTRA_CHANGES",worker.get("new_paths"))
 raise SystemExit(33)
status=subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(source),"status","--porcelain"],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
if status.stdout.strip():
 print("BLOCKER=SOURCE_MUTATED")
 raise SystemExit(34)
run_root=Path(res["run_directory"])
log=run_root/(worker["id"]+".jsonl")
events=[]
for line in log.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
 try:events.append(json.loads(line))
 except ValueError:pass
started=[e.get("thread_id") for e in events if e.get("type")=="thread.started"]
completed=[e for e in events if e.get("type")=="turn.completed"]
if not started or not completed:
 print("BLOCKER=MISSING_REAL_CODEX_EVENTS")
 raise SystemExit(35)
usage=completed[-1].get("usage") or {}
print("REAL_THREAD_ID",started[-1])
print("REAL_WORKER_ID",worker["id"],"STATUS",worker["status"],"EXIT",worker["exit_code"],"DURATION",worker.get("duration_seconds"))
print("REAL_WORKER_USAGE",json.dumps({k:v for k,v in usage.items() if k in ("input_tokens","cached_input_tokens","output_tokens","total_tokens")}))
print("SOURCE_CLEAN",True)
print("EXPECTED_MARKER_CONTENT",file.read_text().strip())
print("WORKER_CHANGED_PATHS",json.dumps(worker.get("new_paths")))
print("LIVE_VPS_CODEX_CLI_TEST_PASS")
shutil.rmtree(root)
print("ISOLATED_TEST_FILES_REMOVED")
PY
